passage.label: The believer urging his people to follow him to the way of right conduct; this worldly life only temporary enjoyment while the Hereafter is the home of settlement; evil recompensed by its like while righteous believers male or female enter Paradise with provision without account; his question why he invites to salvation while they invite to the Fire; their call to disbelief and association without knowledge against his call to the Mighty Perpetual Forgiver; the invoked objects answering no supplication in this world or the next, return being to Allah with transgressors as Fire-companions; his notice that they will remember his words and his entrusting his affair to Allah who sees His servants; Allah protecting him from their plotted evils while Pharaoh's people were enveloped by the worst punishment; the Fire shown morning and evening with the order at the Hour to enter them into the severest punishment; their argument in the Fire where the weak ask the arrogant to relieve a share, answered that all are in it and Allah has judged; their request to Hell's keepers to supplicate for one day's relief, met by the question about messengers with clear proofs and the reply to supplicate themselves since disbelievers' supplication is only in error

arabicExcerpts.text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَتَٰعٞ وَإِنَّ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ ٱلۡقَرَارِ
مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةٗ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
۞وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيٓ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
تَدۡعُونَنِي لِأَكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ وَأَنَا۠ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡغَفَّـٰرِ
لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوّٗا وَعَشِيّٗاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
وَإِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُلّٞ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡعِبَادِ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَأۡتِيكُمۡ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰۚ قَالُواْ فَٱدۡعُواْۗ وَمَا دُعَـٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٍ

mainSubject.label: The believer's invitation to right conduct set against Pharaoh's claim; worldly life reduced to temporary enjoyment against the Hereafter as permanent settlement; exact recompense for evil with unaccounted provision for righteous believers of either sex; the mutual-invitation paradox of salvation against Fire; association without knowledge contrasted with the call to the Mighty Perpetual Forgiver; the impotence of invoked objects to answer any supplication in either realm; his forecast of their remembrance and his entrustment of the affair to the Seeing Lord; divine protection of him and enveloping punishment of Pharaoh's household; morning-and-evening exposure to the Fire before the severest entry at the Hour; the internal quarrel where followers seek relief from leaders who admit shared confinement under divine judgement; the keepers' refusal redirecting supplication back to those who already received clear proofs

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the travel-and-seizure argument (22) before Musa's commission opens (23); P2 ends with Pharaoh's ruined tower plan (37); P3 runs from the believer's invitation through the Fire dialogues (38-50); P4 covers the support promise, patience commands and creation signs to the Be-and-it-is decree (51-68); P5 begins with the disputers' aversion and runs through dragging, livestock signs and the ineffective deathbed faith (69-85).
